title: The export menu is desactivated
body: ### Bug description The export menu is desactivated by default. ### Steps to reproduce 1. open audacity 4 2. add an audio 3. The export menu is desactivated by default. I cannot export the audio. ### Expected behavior The export menu is enabled. ### Actual behavior _No response_ ### Audacity Version Audacity 4.0.1 ### Operating system macOS ### Additional context _No response_
